researchQuestion: Does the frozen ChoiceScreen/existing-consumer Dusk acquisition contract preserve exact current-main whole-run identity when omitted or explicitly off, and does its enabled direct surface add only one accepted existing Dusk consumer without RNG, payoff, progression or save-schema drift?
claimBoundary: This is an implementation-identity preflight. It may prove null path identity and direct mediator isolation, then authorise a zero-new-row policy-capacity audit. It cannot establish acquisition support, package activation, causal benefit, RandomBuild safety, detector admission, a product candidate or shipping scope. Enabled whole-run execution is prohibited.

factorDefinition.name: duskExclusiveAcquisition
factorDefinition.type: research-only deterministic pre-run acquisition surface outside the sampled policy vector

levels.omitted: Call the prototype simulator through its legacy arity so the new trailing argument is omitted.
levels.off: Pass the explicit false trailing argument; do not evaluate a package choice or add a profile key.
levels.pilot: For Dusk only, call BalancePilot.choose_card over executioner then guardedStrike with a null RNG, accept the best only when its unchanged card_score meets unchanged cardDecline, and pass at most that one existing consumer to RunState.new_run.

factorDefinition.productUiShape: After the existing Embark decision and only once poolWave2 is revealed, application/main.gd may reuse _show_choice and existing ChoiceScreen to present the same two existing consumers. Product UI is not implemented in this research preflight.
factorDefinition.persistence: RunState adds the selected existing consumer to player.deck. The existing save dictionary serialises and reloads that CardInst; there is no package field, marker or migration.
factorDefinition.mutualExclusion: The fixed ordered choice list contains executioner and guardedStrike and returns at most one ID. A policy below cardDecline returns none.
factorDefinition.duskQualification: Only aspect duskblade may evaluate or receive the choice. Ashwarden is an exact no-op.
factorDefinition.progression: The prospective product surface is gated at poolWave2 because executioner is already gated there; guardedStrike has no later gate. The mature research profile already reveals all current pool waves.
factorDefinition.rng: The selector omits the optional RNG argument. Even under RandomBuild, choose_card therefore follows its deterministic score path and no RNG object is read or advanced.
factorDefinition.scorelinePayoff: Separate exact-current factor, fixed and byte-identical in content.
factorDefinition.afterimagePayoff: Separate exact-current factor, fixed and byte-identical in content.
factorDefinition.acquisitionPriority: Exact current and unmodified. This factor does not reopen packageOrder, commitment or an acquisition-priority scalar.
factorDefinition.allowedDirectDifference: For an accepted Dusk choice only, append one base non-upgraded CardInst with the selected existing consumer ID and advance only the CardInst UID cursor by one. The existing starter deck, producers, content, policy snapshot and RNG remain exact.
factorDefinition.forbiddenDirectEffects: No new ID, save field, content definition, payoff, score, threshold, producer, second consumer, relic, status, unlock, RNG call, Ash change, policy method, ML, RL or optimiser.

identityCohort.identity: All three arms use every one of the same 64 freshly sampled policy identities and four fresh simulation seed identities. No row is selected, removed, replaced or added after execution.

anchors.pristine: Fresh exact-current-main rows under qualified Godot 4.7.2 are the baseline; no older 4.7.1 output or research-modified cache is reused.
anchors.null: Prototype omitted and explicit-off use the exact same policies, simulation seeds, content, Dusk Vow-5 setting and full whole-run estimator as pristine.
anchors.direct: Each direct control constructs null and enabled RunState values from the same content and seed, compares deck, UID and RNG, then reloads the enabled save through current RunState.from_save_dict.
anchors.content: The exact current Chisel, Ward, Faultline and Warden's Edge definitions remain byte-identical. Both producers remain in the starter deck; only one existing consumer may be appended.

estimands.baselineIdentity: Exact canonical dictionary equality for pristine current-main versus prototype omitted across all 256 identities.
estimands.explicitNullIdentity: Exact canonical dictionary equality for prototype omitted versus prototype explicit-off across all 256 identities.
estimands.rngIdentity: Exact final RNG equality across all three whole-run arms for every policy-seed identity and exact null-versus-enabled RunState RNG equality in every direct case.
estimands.policyIdentity: Exact resolved policy snapshot equality across all three whole-run arms for every identity.
estimands.outcomeIdentity: Exact outcome equality across all three whole-run arms; every shared baseline error or stall must remain shared rather than selected away.
estimands.directSelection: The fixed policies select Faultline, select Warden's Edge, decline both, retain deterministic Warden's Edge under RandomBuild with null RNG, no-op on Ash and no-op when explicitly off exactly as registered.
estimands.directIsolation: An accepted Dusk choice appends exactly one base existing consumer after the unchanged starter deck, advances only UID by one, consumes no RNG, preserves both producers and content definitions, and round-trips through the existing save deck. Every non-choice case is exact null.
estimands.trustBoundary: An unregistered acquisition value must terminate non-zero before any output row. Enabled whole-run is absent from the deterministic plan and rejected by the probe.
estimands.notEstimated: No enabled whole-run outcome, policy support, choice distribution, package activation, causal effect, RandomBuild movement, duration, detector endpoint, product UX, protected-seed or shipping result is estimated.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python validates every immutable source and hash, rejects an invalid level, builds all direct cases and the complete common-random-number null rectangle, invokes the exact absolute Godot binary, content-addresses plans and outputs, performs exact comparisons and owns stop/go.
order: Reject one invalid acquisition value before an output row.
Execute all six fixed direct cases once; any mismatch stops identity admission.
Execute the 256-row pristine current-main rectangle once.
Execute the fixed 512-row prototype omitted-plus-explicit-off rectangle once.
Compare exact rows, RNG, policy, outcome, direct deck/save effects and ledger identity once.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The complete 774-row identity design is the only look. No enabled whole-run, cohort change, repair, reserve or rerun exists.
executionAndStopping.stagedConstraint: Direct enabled evidence supports mediator isolation only. Every endpoint-bearing whole-run arm is null and comparably evaluated on the same complete cohort.

decisionRules.success: The invalid value fails closed; all six direct controls match their frozen choice, aspect, cardDecline, zero-RNG, one-consumer, content/payoff and existing-save expectations; all 256 pristine-versus-omitted and 256 omitted-versus-explicit-off rows are exact; RNG, policy and outcome mismatches are zero; exactly 774 identity observations and zero enabled whole-run, causal, ledger or protected rows execute within 300 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze the exact Dusk acquisition implementation as identity-safe and proceed only to one separately preregistered zero-new-row policy-capacity audit on immutable policies. Do not run enabled whole-run or causal rows, implement product UI, alter the selector, add a method or use protected seeds before capacity passes.
decisionRules.futility: The invalid value fails open, any registered direct expectation fails, any whole-run null row/RNG/policy/outcome differs, an unintended field moves, or the ledger changes.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the exact ChoiceScreen/existing-consumer acquisition contract without repair, retune or rerun and continue inside issue 421 with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism. Do not change the consumer list, UI path, selector, cohort, threshold or null encoding and do not create a successor.
decisionRules.inconclusive: An immutable input, exact Godot process, output schema, row count or 300-second cap is unavailable before a valid identity decision.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the identity preflight inconclusive at the cap with no enabled whole-run or causal inference. Preserve the safe state and continue only under the current issue 421 authority contract; escalate only if no evidence-backed continuation remains and the relevant gate is genuinely unavailable.

methodBoundary: Issues 524 and 525 remain immutable evidence and are not reconstructed. Scoreline and Afterimage payoffs remain separate and fixed. Deterministic code owns construction, execution, caching and stop/go; no human label, model context, optimiser, ML, RL or adaptive candidate step enters execution.
